ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Exhibitor sales, Contract sent and later stages need Amount, Payment terms and Close date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Exhibitor_sales", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Qualified", 2, "Space held", 3, "Contract sent", 4, "Confirmed", 5, 0) >= 4, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(TEXT(Payment_terms__c)), ISBLANK(CloseDate)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Payment terms and Close date before moving to Contract sent.
